findings.evidence: grep hits: Reciprocal.lean:45 is `isCompletelyMonotone_inv_const_add`; Reciprocal.lean:83 is only the special `isCompletelyMonotone_one_div_one_add`; Closure.lean:99 has `IsCompletelyMonotone.pow`, but `rg` finds no reciprocal zpow or general one-div theorem in the new module.
findings.fix: Add named public bridge theorems for general `fun t => 1 / (a + t)` and for the zpow/natural negative-power form, proving the latter via the existing closure theorem with any closure import kept non-public if it is proof-only.
findings.issue: The module exposes only `IsCompletelyMonotone (fun t => (a + t)⁻¹)` plus the special `1 / (1 + t)` case, but the PR-facing API advertises the `1 / (a + t)` phrasing and integer powers `t ↦ (a + t)^{-k}`.

summary: The reciprocal theorem itself is narrowly exposed, but the public API omits the advertised general `1 / (a + t)` and integer-power/zpow forms, leaving downstream users to rebuild bridge lemmas.
